fine_grid.rule: log half-intervals; boundaries extend outward by half the adjacent log interval; retain winner exactly; 12 significant digit new endpoints

review.selection: mean accuracy descending; mean validation loss ascending; canonical search trial ID ascending

stp: Exp9 Scale: s=1/(sqrt(previous completed vhat)+eps_scale); clip s*g; add noise in scaled sum space; undo scaling; divide by1000; standard Adam

matrices.bandinvmf: 4 inverse Toeplitz bands, BISR initialization (bias uses momentum BISR), full A objective, L-BFGS
matrices.b2lt: PDF section5 exact finite exponential mix, P=K=T/5,Q=5, exact log barrier, accepted-iterate raw E2 selection
matrices.dtc: PDF section7 directly optimize all T-1 monotone nonnegative C coefficients, linear initial c, exact gap barrier, accepted-iterate raw E2 selection including IID

solver.lambda_barrier: 1e-4 * initial_E2 / number_of_variables, fixed throughout each solve; zero for BandInvMF
solver.relative_tolerance: relative improvement <=1e-12 plus normalized maxabs gradient<1e-5
solver.selection: minimum raw E2 among feasible accepted iterates, DTC also IID; iteration cap/stall recorded without claiming convergence

matrices.objective: Sens(C)^2 * ||A C^-1||_F^2 / T; fixed-epoch absolute Gram bound over every offset j=0..K-1

privacy.calibration: GDP delta(mu,eps)=Phi(-eps/mu+mu/2)-exp(eps)Phi(-eps/mu-mu/2); sigma_sum=clip*Sens(C)/mu; gradient mean covariance=sigma_sum^2 D D^T/1000^2
privacy.pdf_calibration: PDF conservative sigma formula is deliberately not used
privacy.scope: per training only; internal validation assumed public; no tuning or repetition composition guarantee

datasets.cv: Exp9 45000/5000 stratified split seed20261008; search/review225 steps; formal50000 train+10000 official test250 steps; ViT Tiny224; logical1000 physical250; five epochs FP32
datasets.nlp: Exp9 62000/5349 split and tokenizer maxlen128; BERT Tiny dropout.1; official872 after freeze; T310; logical=physical1000; five epochs FP32

rng: Exp9 initialization/order/augmentations; same order every epoch; noise independent seed+1; dropout seed+100000+step
scheduling: physical0/1/2/3; CV exclusive1; otherwise NLP at most2 independent workers; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES; no DDP or batch/precision fallbacks
failures: no silent retry; OOM/engineering/calibration/hash failure stops new launches, active workers finish; explicit non_finite search/review excluded with evidence, formal any failure stops
recovery: reuse only identity/protocol/core/input/matrix/config/artifact hash matching successful runs; partial/engineering failures require explicit inspection; no automatic checkpoint continuation
read_only: all generated files under exp16a; every other repository file size/mtime snapshot verified before/after; data/cache offline
report: 10 paired seeds; mean/sample SD; t95% CIs and all pairwise differences; utility/matrixerror/sensitivity/runtime/memory separate files; no blind-test claim
